import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w['r']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
def ci(d):
  rng=np.random.default_rng(1);gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby(['genre','late'])]
  b=[est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])) for i in range(1000)]
  return est(d),np.percentile(b,[2.5,97.5])
print(ci(w[w.date_confidence=='high']))
print(ci(w[~w.genre.isin(['romance','collection'])]))
print(ci(w[w.n_editions==1]))
